items.title: Dead End Sign Not Found
items.description: Dark 404 on a night road: a DEAD END warning sign beside a highway guide sign, then a monospace code, large headline, body and home button. Pulls in Geist Mono and Hanken Grotesk.

items.name: about-01
items.title: About Section with Process Steps
items.description: Process section in Instrument Serif: an eyebrow beside a long statement heading, a rule, then three numbered steps (Install, Compose, Deploy), each with a short list.

items.name: about-04
items.title: Split About with Gradient Strips
items.description: Dark split section: a heading and two paragraphs on one side, and a full-bleed panel of nine painted gradient strips stepping from blue to coral under sandpaper grain on the other.

items.name: about-08
items.title: About Office Locations
items.description: Offices section: a heading and visiting note above four city entries, each marked by a thin left rule with a primary accent at the title, and a street address set in an address element.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Bordered accordion on Base UI with item, trigger and animated content panel. Open items take a muted tint, and the caret flips between down and up as a panel expands.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: Workspace activity card built on ActivityFeedCard: a large event count, a timeline of deploys, merges and comments with one highlighted event, a 48-hour summary row and a full-width View all link.

items.name: activity-feed-card
items.title: Activity Feed Card
items.description: Activity card with a large display count, a Timeline of actor, action and target events with times and optional comments, featured dots in the art accent, and an optional period summary footer.

items.name: activity-goal
items.title: Activity Goal
items.description: A focus-goal card with a 13-day recharts bar chart of minutes against an adjustable goal line, stepper buttons, a met count and a Set goal button that announces the saved value.

items.name: activity-goal-card
items.title: Activity Goal Card
items.description: Goal card with a large adjustable target, minus and plus buttons, and a recharts bar chart where entries that meet the goal fill in the art accent above a dashed line. Requires recharts 3.8.0.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline status callout with title, description and an optional top-right action slot. Default and destructive variants; a leading icon moves the text into a second column.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Modal confirmation dialog on Base UI with blurred overlay, header, optional media circle, title, description and footer. Action and Cancel render as Buttons; a small size sets them side by side in two equal columns.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: News pill link built on the secondary Badge, with a headline that truncates first and a Learn more action set off by a short vertical Separator. Renders an anchor through Base UI useRender.

items.name: app-stats
items.title: Weekly Installs Card
items.description: A compact stats card for weekly installs: a large total, a hairline recharts line over eight weeks with only the latest point in the accent, and a change caption. Labels use Geist Mono; recharts is pinned to 3.8.0.

items.name: arc
items.title: Arc
items.description: Ring of light in three looks: a soft conic fade, an outline with a faint track and bright stroke, and a short traveling highlight. ArcLayer groups positioned arcs; spin is opt-in and stops for reduced motion.

items.name: area-chart-01
items.title: Listeners Area Chart Card
items.description: Card with a two-series area chart of daily listeners, desktop solid and mobile dashed, a select for 90, 30 or 7 days and a legend that draws the dash. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Plain wrapper that holds its children to a numeric width-to-height ratio through a CSS variable and the native aspect-ratio property. No client JavaScript or primitive library.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: File attachment chip with media, title, description and action slots, in three sizes and horizontal or vertical layout. Upload states show a dashed idle edge, a shimmering title and an error tint.

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit Log
items.description: Dense security audit log in a card: one timeline row per event with the actor in bold, a right-aligned time and a muted Geist Mono line of IP, key or device detail, plus an Export button.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round avatar on Base UI with image, fallback initials and a corner status badge, in small, default and large sizes. AvatarGroup overlaps faces with a ring and adds a remaining-count circle.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small pill label in default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost and link variants. Built on Base UI useRender so it can render as a link; the filled and outline variants tint on hover only as anchors.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Dismissible announcement bar with start and centered variants, a background slot for art, a link that becomes a full-bar tap target on phones, and a dismiss button that hands focus onward.

items.name: banner-05
items.title: Neoconstruct Event Banner
items.description: Neoconstruct banner on cream paper with a hard ink rule below: a red Ribbon Badge for the seats left, the workshop notice, and a small Neoconstruct button with an arrow and an offset shadow that keeps its label on phones.

items.name: bar-chart-01
items.title: Monthly Column Bar Chart
items.description: Card with a monthly column chart of sessions, the value printed above each rounded bar, and a footer with a trend sentence and icon plus a note. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: bar-chart-02
items.title: Horizontal Ranking Bar Chart
items.description: Card with a horizontal bar chart ranking five countries by listeners, country names on the axis and values printed at the end of each bar. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: bar-chart-03
items.title: Diverging Bar Chart
items.description: Card with a diverging column chart of week-on-week change by day, bars rising and falling from a zero reference line with signed percentage labels. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: blog-01
items.title: Three-Card Blog Grid
items.description: Centred blog section with a heading and intro over a three-column grid of posts. Each card shows cover art, date and author, a linked title and a one-sentence excerpt.

items.name: blog-02
items.title: Blog with Featured Post
items.description: Two-column blog layout with one large featured post beside a divided list of three dated posts. Text only, no images, with a long excerpt on the featured story.

items.name: blog-03
items.title: Blog Rows with Cover Art
items.description: Guides list with a left-aligned header over full-width rows. Each row pairs cover art with a date, category tag, linked title, longer excerpt and author line.

items.name: blog-04
items.title: Text-Only Blog Grid
items.description: Text-only blog grid of six posts in three columns under a ruled top edge. Each post shows date, category, linked title, excerpt and a bold author name.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb trail of list, item, link, current page, caret separator and ellipsis parts. The link part uses Base UI useRender, so a framework router link can stand in for the anchor.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Chat bubble with group, content and reactions parts. Variants cover primary, secondary, muted, a primary-tinted fill, outline, ghost and destructive; bubbles align to the start or end.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Base UI button with default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive and link variants. Sizes run from xs to lg plus four square icon sizes, with focus ring and invalid states included.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs and select triggers into one segmented control by squaring inner corners and collapsing shared borders. Horizontal or vertical, with a text cell and a Separator part.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date picker grid built on react-day-picker with Button-styled navigation, phosphor caret icons and single or range selection styling. Supports dropdown captions, week numbers and RTL arrows.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Rounded surface with header, title, description, action, content and footer slots. A small size tightens the spacing, and an image placed first bleeds to the card's rounded top edge.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slide carousel built on embla-carousel-react with content, item, previous and next parts. Horizontal or vertical axis, arrow-key navigation, plugin support and a hook that exposes the embla API.

items.name: centered-footer-01
items.title: Centered Footer with Social Icons
items.description: Centred minimal footer: one row of five links, Threads, Mastodon and Discord icon links beneath, and a copyright line. Built on the Footer parts.

items.name: changelog
items.title: Changelog
items.description: Release changelog on a timeline: each entry opens with a mono version and date, a Latest badge on the newest, a summary line, and New, Improved or Fixed badges against each change.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts 3.8.0 wrapper with a responsive container, config-driven light and dark series colors, and tooltip and legend content. Tooltip values use the mono font, so it installs Geist Mono.

items.name: chat-code-block
items.title: Chat Code Block
items.description: Fenced code surface for chat replies, pinned dark in both modes, with a language label and copy button. Lazy-loads Shiki for highlighting and waits until a streamed fence closes.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: Chat message form with an auto-growing textarea that stops at a fixed height and scrolls, and a send button that turns into stop while a reply streams. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

items.name: chat-conversation
items.title: Chat Conversation
items.description: Scrolling chat transcript built on Message Scroller: a polite live log that follows the streaming edge, with turn, attribution, pulsing cursor and shimmering status parts.

items.name: chat-history-01
items.title: Chat History Sidebar
items.description: Conversation history sidebar with a New conversation button, a search field and a list whose rows rename inline or delete from a dropdown menu. Shows an empty state when nothing matches.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: A single chat turn: the user's message in a muted bubble aligned to the end, the assistant's as bare text at the start. Built on Message and Bubble.

items.name: chat-message-demo
items.title: Chat Message Demo
items.description: Chat Message both ways: the person's message in a bubble on the right, the assistant's reply as bare text on the left.

items.name: chat-message-long-reply
items.title: Chat Message Long Reply
items.description: A long assistant reply in Chat Message, its paragraphs and numbered list kept as written.

items.name: chat-message-mine
items.title: Chat Message Mine
items.description: The person's own message: variant mine, on the right in a soft bubble.

items.name: chat-message-theirs
items.title: Chat Message Theirs
items.description: The assistant's reply: variant theirs, on the left as bare text with no bubble.

items.name: chat-message-thread
items.title: Chat Message Thread
items.description: A four-turn conversation built from Chat Message: the person's turns in bubbles on the right, the assistant's replies as bare text on the left.

items.name: chat-message-with-code
items.title: Chat Message With Code
items.description: A question and an answer that carries code: Chat Message for the two paragraphs and Chat Code Block for the snippet between them.

items.name: chat-response
items.title: Chat Response
items.description: Renders an assistant's streamed text, splitting fenced code into Chat Code Blocks and setting inline backtick code in mono, with a slot for a cursor at the end.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Base UI checkbox with a filled primary checked state, check icon indicator and an enlarged invisible hit area. Includes focus ring, disabled and invalid styling and works inside Field labels.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Four-step checkout card (cart, shipping, payment, review) with numbered, clickable step triggers that turn to checks. Each step validates with react-hook-form and zod before Continue.

items.name: checkout-bars
items.title: Checkout Bars
items.description: Bars twin of Checkout: the same four steps validated with react-hook-form and zod, but progress is a row of rail segments with screen-reader titles instead of numbered triggers.

items.name: cloud-dancer-slider
items.title: Cloud Dancer Slider
items.description: Base UI slider dressed as the Cloud Dancer pill: a teal-shaded off-white strip with a dark filled range and a dark orb thumb. Takes one value or a range, with a label per thumb.

items.name: cloud-dancer-switch
items.title: Cloud Dancer Switch
items.description: A Base UI switch with a cream pill groove shaded teal that warms to rose when checked, and a dark void orb for a thumb. Default and small sizes, client component.

items.name: cloud-shapes
items.title: Cloud Shapes
items.description: Paper-white shapes lit with a two-color crescent shadow, in fourteen geometries from circle and pill to egg, arch and shield. Pinned to a daylight look; shading deepens on dark grounds.

items.name: cloud-stack-loader
items.title: Cloud Stack Loader
items.description: Vertical column of three paper circles that take their color in turn from top to bottom while the others rest in grey. Height sets the size; reduced motion fades instead of scaling.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Unstyled Base UI collapsible with root, trigger and content panel parts. It adds only slot attributes, so the open and closed look is left entirely to the consumer.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select on Base UI with an InputGroup field, trigger and clear buttons, grouped list, empty state and check indicators. A chips mode adds removable chips for multiple selection.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette built on cmdk with a search input, filtered list, groups, items, shortcuts and separators. CommandDialog opens it inside Dialog with a screen-reader-only title and description.

items.name: compact-steps
items.title: Compact Steps
items.description: Small new-project card that walks three steps (name, details, access) with a row of dot indicators and the current step title beside them, for dialogs where a full stepper is too loud.

items.name: contact-form-01
items.title: Contact Sales Form
items.description: Contact sales form in one narrow column: first and last name, optional company, email, country select with phone, message and a privacy consent checkbox. Validated with react-hook-form and zod.

items.name: contact-list
items.title: Contact List
items.description: A responsive grid of six contact cards, up to three columns, each with a greyscale Cloud shape avatar, name, role badge and title, and a ruled footer split into Email and Call links.

items.name: contact-list-card
items.title: Contact List Card
items.description: A single card listing four on-call contacts as rows with a greyscale Cloud shape avatar, name, title and an outline Email button. Rows are divided by hairlines under a header and description.

items.name: contact-offices-01
items.title: Contact Departments and Offices
items.description: Contact section in two intro-column rows: department cards with mailto and tel links, then office cards with street addresses. Built from Section, Card and DescriptionList with Orbcore sample details.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click menu on Base UI with items, destructive variant, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, keyboard shortcuts and nested submenus. Opens to the right of the pointer by default.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: CTA with Onboarding Steps
items.description: Centered CTA with heading, description and a Book a walkthrough button above three onboarding steps on Milestones, joined by one rule and aligned left, center and right.

items.name: cta-03
items.title: Dark Email Signup CTA
items.description: Pinned-dark email signup with a centered Instrument Serif headline, description and a glass pill input group holding the email field and Get started button, over a warm grained floor.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A card holding a Date Range Picker: a labelled trigger that opens a two-month range calendar in a popover, preset to a 20-day span. Uses date-fns to build the default range.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Date range field: an outline button showing the formatted range opens a popover with a two-month range Calendar. Works controlled or uncontrolled and formats dates with date-fns.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Semantic label and value rows for order details, specifications or account details. Default spaces rows on a gap; divided rules a line between them. Long values wrap under their term.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Centred modal dialog on Base UI with blurred overlay, header, title, description and footer. A ghost close Button sits in the top corner by default, and the footer can add its own Close button.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Re-exports the Base UI DirectionProvider and useDirection hook so a subtree can switch between left-to-right and right-to-left layout for the primitives that read text direction.

items.name: domain-setup
items.title: Domain Setup
items.description: Custom-domain card in three numbered steps: enter the domain, copy the A and CNAME records from a monospace block, then verify with a pending or active badge. The check is a stand-in.

items.name: domain-setup-bars
items.title: Domain Setup Bars
items.description: Segmented-bar version of Domain Setup: the same domain, DNS record and verification panels in a card, with progress drawn as bars and step titles kept for screen readers.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Swipeable drawer on Base UI that opens from any edge, with snap points, nested drawer stacking, an optional swipe handle and an overlay that fades with swipe progress. Modal by default.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Button-triggered menu on Base UI with items, destructive variant, checkbox and radio items, group labels, shortcuts and nested submenus. The popup is at least as wide as its trigger and animates in.

items.name: eclipse-loader
items.title: Eclipse Loader
items.description: Paper-lit sphere crossed by a dark void disc that slides in, pauses to cover it and slides out on a four-second loop. Sized in pixels; reduced motion fades the void in place.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty-state layout with header, media, title, description and content slots, centred inside a padded box. The media slot has a plain variant and an icon variant on a muted rounded square.

items.name: exercise-minutes
items.title: Exercise Minutes
items.description: Card with a two-line chart comparing this week's exercise minutes against the average by day, both drawn in primary ink with the average at half strength. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: Short label set above a heading. Default is 12px uppercase Geist Mono with wide tracking in muted ink; sans is a 14px semibold line in sentence case. Pulls in the Geist Mono font item.

items.name: faq
items.title: Faq
items.description: Expandable FAQ built on the stock Accordion. Pass an array of entries with an id, question and answer; each becomes an accordion item whose trigger keeps a visible focus outline.

items.name: faq-accordion-01
items.title: Two-Column FAQ Accordion
items.description: Two-column FAQ with a short heading on the left and an accordion of five install and licensing questions on the right. Answers expand one at a time on click.

items.name: faq-grid-01
items.title: Three-Column FAQ Grid
items.description: FAQ grid of nine short questions and answers in three columns under a heading and a support link. Built for brief answers that read at a glance.

items.name: faq-list
items.title: Faq List
items.description: Always-open FAQ as a description list on Grid. Stack sets question and answer pairs in up to three columns; split rules the pairs apart and sets each question beside its answer when wide.

items.name: features
items.title: Features
items.description: Feature list parts: a Grid rendered as a list in one to four columns or a divided single column, with feature, title and description parts and an outline item that rules its left edge.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field system with fieldset, legend, group, label, title, description, separator and error parts. Vertical, horizontal and container-responsive layouts; the error part dedupes messages.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: An Explorer card showing a nested project file tree with collapsible folders, rotating carets and the selected file's path in the header. Folder and file rows are ghost buttons with Phosphor icons.

items.name: flight-itinerary
items.title: Flight Itinerary
items.description: Flight itinerary timeline with local times as titles, airport codes in Geist Mono tags, a layover row between legs, and a plane mark with a Boarding badge on the current leg.

items.name: font-geist
items.title: Geist
items.description: Geist variable sans, bound to --font-geist. The kit's globals read it first in --font-sans, so it sets the default body face for every component without being listed per item.

items.name: font-geist-mono
items.title: Geist Mono
items.description: Geist Mono variable, bound to --font-geist-mono and read by --font-mono in the globals. Pulled in by items with mono labels and code, such as Eyebrow, Chart, Thermal Button and the chat pieces.

font.family: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

items.name: font-hanken-grotesk
items.title: Hanken Grotesk
items.description: Hanken Grotesk variable sans, bound to --font-hanken. The display face for Heading, Hero, Footer and Quote, pulled in by many blocks and by components such as Magazine Cover.

font.family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: font-instrument-serif
items.title: Instrument Serif
items.description: Instrument Serif at weight 400, bound to --font-instrument-serif with a Georgia fallback. The face the typeset-instrument preset reads, pulled in by blocks such as hero, pricing, features and resources.

items.name: font-marcellus
items.title: Marcellus
items.description: Marcellus at weight 400, an inscriptional serif bound to --font-marcellus-face. It sets the labels of Sphere Button and is pulled in by a few CTA, stats and 404 blocks.

items.name: font-overpass
items.title: Overpass
items.description: Overpass variable sans, bound to --font-overpass, the highway-signage face. Only Road Signs depends on it, so it installs with that component and nowhere else.

items.name: font-unbounded
items.title: Unbounded
items.description: Unbounded variable, a wide display face after Constructivist block lettering, bound to --font-unbounded-face. It is Neoconstruct's heading face and installs with anything that sets data-theme="neoconstruct".

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Composable site footer parts: background, tinted band, wordmark, newsletter column, link columns in counts of two to five, a centered link row, fine print and social links. Links accept your router's Link.

items.name: frosted-button
items.title: Frosted Button
items.description: A translucent Button for use over art: a blurred, faint background-tinted fill with a border and inner glow that follow currentColor. Needs a backdrop behind it for the blur to read.

items.name: frosted-button-demo
items.title: Frosted Button Demo
items.description: Frosted Button at its default size over a rising Moon Sphere.

items.name: frosted-button-icon
items.title: Frosted Button Icon
items.description: A square Frosted Button holding one icon, with an aria-label, over a rising Moon Sphere.

items.name: frosted-button-loading
items.title: Frosted Button Loading
items.description: A disabled Frosted Button with a spinner before its label, over a rising Moon Sphere.

items.name: frosted-button-media-controls
items.title: Frosted Button Media Controls
items.description: Frosted Button in its square icon sizes as a previous, pause and next media control row over a Side Glow rising from the bottom edge.

items.name: frosted-button-pair
items.title: Frosted Button Pair
items.description: A hero call to action over a rising Moon Sphere: a solid Button for the main action and a Frosted Button for the second.

items.name: frosted-button-sizes
items.title: Frosted Button Sizes
items.description: Frosted Button in the extra small, small, default and large sizes over a Side Glow rising from the bottom edge.

items.name: frosted-button-with-icon
items.title: Frosted Button With Icon
items.description: Frosted Button with a play icon before its label, over a Side Glow rising from the bottom edge.

items.name: glow-seam
items.title: Glow Seam
items.description: Two lit divider marks: GlowSeam, a rose horizontal section seam, and StandingSeam, a cool vertical line that lights only the active tab trigger. Each glows on dark and becomes ink on light.

items.name: glow-seam-faq-01
items.title: Dark FAQ with Glow Seam
items.description: Dark FAQ section grouped by topic, each topic a heading and blurb beside its question list, with a GlowSeam line of light dividing one topic from the next. Sample topics cover installing, customizing and licensing.

items.name: grain
items.title: Grain
items.description: Single-layer grain in four treatments: plain noise, paper and sandpaper at overlay, square at soft-light. Intensity steps from fine to rich or takes an exact opacity; isolated contains the paint.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Container-query grid that steps from one column up to six by the width of its own wrapper rather than the viewport, with shared gap sizes from xs to xl. The base for most editorial groups.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Section heading in the display face, Hanken Grotesk through the --font-display variable, at four sizes that step up with the Section container. Renders an h2 by default; the tag can be swapped.

items.name: help-search
items.title: Help Search
items.description: Searchable help card that filters question and answer text as you type, announces the result count, and offers clear-search and support actions when nothing matches.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Hero section parts: a full-height container-query frame, an absolute background layer for scenes, stack or split inner layouts, a display headline in three sizes, description, actions and media slot.

items.name: history-milestones-01
items.title: Company History Milestones
items.description: Company history in three columns under a top rule, one per year, each with a date, title and paragraph. No markers; a header and description sit above.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Hover-triggered preview card on Base UI PreviewCard with trigger and a positioned popover-styled panel. Placement defaults to below the trigger, centred, with a short zoom and fade.

items.name: import-wizard
items.title: Import Wizard
items.description: Four-step CSV contact import with numbered triggers: a drop zone that reads the file's name and row count in the browser, a column mapping table, a preview table and an import step.

items.name: import-wizard-bars
items.title: Import Wizard Bars
items.description: Bars variant of Import Wizard: CSV upload with an in-browser row count, column mapping, a preview table and import confirmation, tracked by a segmented rail rather than numbered steps.

items.name: incident-timeline
items.title: Incident Timeline
items.description: Status-page incident report with a Resolved badge, duration and affected services in the header, then four updates newest first, from Resolved back to Investigating, each with a time and note.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text input on Base UI with a soft filled background, rounded pill shape and file-input styling. Includes focus ring, disabled and invalid states, and drops to small text from md up.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Wraps an Input or Textarea with inline or block addons for icons, text, keyboard hints and small buttons. Clicking an addon focuses the input, and the whole group carries one focus ring.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: One-time code input built on the input-otp package with grouped slots, a blinking fake caret and a dash separator. The active slot shows a focus ring and invalid groups turn destructive.

items.name: install-command
items.title: Install Command
items.description: Copyable shell command in an InputGroup: a $ prompt, the command in Geist Mono and a copy button. If copying fails it selects the text and shows a hint; add the dark class over art.

items.name: install-guide
items.title: Install Guide
items.description: Vertical, non-linear install checklist with a shadcn CLI command in a monospace block under each open step. Done, next ticks the step and moves focus to the following title.

items.name: install-switcher
items.title: Install Switcher
items.description: Install command with the package manager as a gliding segmented switch inside the pill: pick pnpm, npm, yarn or bun and the command rewrites; the copy button copies the one showing. Narrow, the switch takes the pill's top row. Add the dark class over art.

items.name: issue-report-form
items.title: Issue Report Form
items.description: Issue report card with area and severity selects, a subject input and a details textarea under mono uppercase labels. Validates with react-hook-form and zod, sends FormData to a React action, then resets.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Flexible list row with media, content, title, description, actions, header and footer parts. Default, outline and muted variants in three densities; renders as a link through Base UI useRender.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Inline keyboard key label in a small muted rounded box, plus a group wrapper for key combinations. Adapts its colors when placed inside an input group or a tooltip.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Plain form label with small medium-weight text that dims when its peer control or parent field is disabled. A native label element with no primitive library dependency.

items.name: line-chart-01
items.title: Labelled Line Chart Card
items.description: Card with a single-series line chart of average session minutes by month, each point labelled with its value, and a footer note on the trend. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: Logo cloud parts: a labelled list laid out as a centred grid, a single wrapping baseline, two columns or muted tiles. Each logo takes an img, svg or text wordmark at three sizes, with a greyscale muted variant.

items.name: logo-cloud-02
items.title: Slim Dark Logo Cloud
items.description: Slim dark strip of five muted text wordmarks spread edge to edge in a wrapping row, named for screen readers by a hidden label while the row shows names only.

items.name: logo-cloud-05
items.title: Logo Cloud with Glow Seam
items.description: Light logo grid of six icon-and-name marks above a GlowSeam rule, closed by a line of customer copy and an underlined link to customer stories.

items.name: logo-cloud-07
items.title: Minimal Icon Logo Cloud
items.description: The plainest logo cloud: six Phosphor icon marks with names in a centred grid that runs to a single row on wide screens, with no heading or copy.

items.name: logo-cloud-09
items.title: Mona Sans Wordmark Logo Cloud
items.description: Eight wordmarks set in Mona Sans, told apart by weight, width and tracking. Installs Mona Sans from Fontsource with its width axis.

items.name: loop-settings-form
items.title: Loop Settings Form
items.description: Loop settings card with loop in and out times typed as m:ss, a large computed loop length, and fade in and out times in a collapsible section. Mono labels; controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Small muted inline note line with icon and content slots. Variants add hairline rules on both sides of centred text or a bottom border; renders as any element through Base UI useRender.

items.name: mega-footer-01
items.title: Five-Column Mega Footer
items.description: Footer of five link columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal and Social) above a fineprint copyright line, built on the Footer parts.

items.name: menu-button
items.title: Menu Button
items.description: A hamburger icon Button that morphs into a close cross. The animation is driven entirely by aria-expanded, so the visual state and the screen-reader state stay in sync.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Desktop-style menubar on Base UI that holds several menus in one bordered bar. Reuses Dropdown Menu for content, items, shortcuts and nested submenus; its checkbox and radio items show the check on the left.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat message row with group, avatar, content, header and footer parts. Aligns to the start or end and reverses for outgoing messages; pairs with Bubble for the message body.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Chat transcript scroller from @shadcn/react with provider, viewport, content and item parts. Keeps the view pinned while messages stream in, fades the bottom edge and shows a scroll-to-end button.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: Compact KPI card: a metric name, a large tabular value, an optional outline badge with a trend-up or trend-down icon and screen-reader label, and an optional description line.

items.name: milestones
items.title: Milestones
items.description: Roadmap or company history as an ordered list on Grid, in grid or rows layout. Rules can be off, a top border per item, or one fading horizon line with dots; the current milestone's dot is filled.

items.name: minimal-404-01
items.title: Light Not Found with Support
items.description: Plain light 404 with no artwork: centered eyebrow, headline and description, a primary back-home button and a contact-support link with a trailing arrow.

items.name: minimal-404-02
items.title: Left Aligned Not Found
items.description: Left-aligned light 404: eyebrow, headline and description start the column, and a flush arrow link leads home instead of a filled button. No artwork.

items.name: minimal-about-01
items.title: Minimal About Section
items.description: Plain about section: a heading beside two paragraphs, stacking on narrow screens. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-about-02
items.title: Minimal About with Stats
items.description: Plain about section: a heading beside two paragraphs, then a row of three figures with labels. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-banner-01
items.title: Muted Release Banner
items.description: Centered announcement bar on the muted ground with a release note, an arrow link and a dismiss button. A shorter line replaces the message below the md breakpoint.

items.name: minimal-banner-02
items.title: Maintenance Notice Banner
items.description: Start-aligned maintenance notice on the card surface with a bottom border, a clock icon that hides on phones, a status-page link and a dismiss button.

items.name: minimal-banner-03
items.title: Primary Color Banner
items.description: Centered announcement bar filled with the primary color and primary-foreground text, an arrow link and a dismiss button; the message shortens below the sm breakpoint.

items.name: minimal-banner-04
items.title: Billing Warning Banner
items.description: Destructive-tinted alert bar with a faint red ground, red text and a bottom border, carrying a billing warning, an update link and dismiss. The tint deepens in dark mode.

items.name: minimal-cta-01
items.title: Minimal Centered CTA
items.description: Plain centered call to action: a heading, a description and a primary and an outline button. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-cta-02
items.title: Minimal Split CTA
items.description: Plain split call to action: heading and description on the left, a primary and an outline button beside them on wide screens and below on narrow ones. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-features-01
items.title: Minimal Feature Grid
items.description: Plain feature section: a heading and description above a three-column grid of six features, each a title and a line of copy. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-features-02
items.title: Minimal Feature Cards
items.description: Plain feature section: a heading and description above three cards, each with a title, a line of copy and a Learn more link. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-footer-01
items.title: Single-Row Dark Footer
items.description: Single-row footer pinned dark: a brand wordmark, a row of six links and the copyright year, built on the Footer parts.

items.name: minimal-hero-01
items.title: Minimal Centered Hero
items.description: Plain centered hero: a small eyebrow, a large headline, a description and a primary and an outline button. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-hero-02
items.title: Minimal Left-Aligned Hero
items.description: Plain left-aligned hero: a small eyebrow, a large headline, a description and a primary and a ghost button. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-login-01
items.title: Minimal Login Card
items.description: Plain sign-in card: a title, email and password fields with a forgot-password link, a sign-in button and a link to create an account, validated with React Hook Form and Zod. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-navbar-01
items.title: Minimal Navbar
items.description: Minimal navbar for the Eudoxia wordmark: three text links, a ghost log in link and an outline get started button, collapsing to a Sheet menu in narrow containers.

items.name: minimal-pricing-01
items.title: Minimal Three-Plan Pricing
items.description: Plain pricing: a centered heading above three plan cards with price, description, a checked feature list and a button; the featured plan carries a Most popular badge and the primary button. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-pricing-02
items.title: Minimal Single-Plan Pricing
items.description: Plain pricing: a centered heading above one plan card with price, period, a checked feature list and a trial button. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-resources-01
items.title: Minimal Guide Cards
items.description: Plain resources section: a heading above three guide cards, each with a reading time, a title, a line of copy and a Read the guide link. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-stats-01
items.title: Minimal Stats Row
items.description: Plain stats: a heading and description above four figures with labels, each marked by a thin left rule. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-team-01
items.title: Minimal Team List
items.description: Plain team section: a heading and description above eight names with roles in four columns, each marked by a thin left rule. No photos. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-team-02
items.title: Minimal Team with Bios
items.description: Plain team section: a heading and description beside four people, each with a name, role and one-line bio. No photos. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-testimonials-01
items.title: Minimal Pull Quote
items.description: Plain single testimonial: a large centered quote with the speaker's name and role below. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-testimonials-02
items.title: Minimal Testimonial Grid
items.description: Plain testimonials: a heading above three quotes on muted tiles, each with a name and role. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: minimal-testimonials-03
items.title: Minimal Divided Testimonials
items.description: Plain testimonials: a heading above three quotes ruled apart, side by side on wide screens and stacked on narrow ones, each with a name and role. Theme tokens only, light and dark.

items.name: moon-sphere
items.title: Moon Sphere
items.description: A single-element sphere lit on one limb: a radial gradient from the lower-left corner runs transparent out to a warm rim color on the far edge. Used for moonrise effects over dark grounds.

items.name: moon-sphere-blue
items.title: Moon Sphere Blue
items.description: Moon Sphere with a blue rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-demo
items.title: Moon Sphere Demo
items.description: Moon Sphere with its default amber rim on a dark ground. The disc is transparent apart from its lit limb, so it needs a dark surface behind it.

items.name: moon-sphere-green
items.title: Moon Sphere Green
items.description: Moon Sphere with a green rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-pink
items.title: Moon Sphere Pink
items.description: Moon Sphere with a pink rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-red
items.title: Moon Sphere Red
items.description: Moon Sphere with a red rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-rising
items.title: Moon Sphere Rising
items.description: A dark section with a centered heading and line of copy, and a large Moon Sphere rising from its bottom edge.

items.name: moon-sphere-silver
items.title: Moon Sphere Silver
items.description: Moon Sphere with a silver rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-split
items.title: Moon Sphere Split
items.description: A dark band with a quote and byline on the right and a Moon Sphere cropped by the left edge; on phones the moon steps aside.

items.name: moon-sphere-violet
items.title: Moon Sphere Violet
items.description: Moon Sphere with a violet rim on a dark ground.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Styled native select element with a caret icon, small and default sizes, and option and optgroup parts that keep system colors. No custom popup, so platform pickers work on mobile.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Site header built on Navigation Menu in left, centered-links and centered-logo layouts. Container queries hide links on narrow widths and wrap actions; parts include logo, links and actions.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation menu on Base UI with trigger, content, link and indicator parts. A shared popup resizes and slides between panels as the pointer moves across triggers.

items.name: neoconstruct-badge
items.title: Neoconstruct Badge
items.description: Uppercase Oswald badge in gold, red, neutral and subtle tones, plus a ribbon badge with a leading mark. Ships in the Neoconstruct theme.

items.name: neoconstruct-button
items.title: Neoconstruct Button
items.description: Neoconstruct button: hard offset shadow that presses in on hover, default, neutral, outline, ghost and reverse variants, optional mark, arrows, rotation and stripe, plus a ribbon button. Ships in the Neoconstruct theme.

items.name: neoconstruct-marker
items.title: Neoconstruct Marker
items.description: Neoconstruct's ruler-and-compass marks: wedge, slash, disc, ring, plus, square, bar and star, plus a zero-padded numeral. Ships in the Neoconstruct theme.

items.name: open-faq-01
items.title: Always-Open FAQ with Intro
items.description: FAQ with an intro column holding the heading and a support link, beside an always-open list of six questions and answers. No accordion; every answer is visible.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation with previous, next, numbered links and an ellipsis. Links render as anchors styled with Button; the active page takes the outline variant and sets aria-current.

items.name: pie-chart-01
items.title: Donut Chart with Center Total
items.description: Card with a donut chart of minutes by genre, the total printed in the center, and a footer list giving each genre's swatch, minutes and share. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: pool-light
items.title: Pool Light
items.description: Caustic light on a pool floor: two drifting sheets of turbulence ridge lines over a teal gradient with a vignette. Slow screen-blended drift that stops under reduced motion.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Click-triggered floating panel on Base UI with header, title and description parts. Positions below and centred on its trigger by default, with a short zoom and fade on open.

items.name: post
items.title: Post
items.description: Blog post listing parts: a Grid list or divided column of posts, each made fully clickable by its title link, with cover media, dotted meta for date, category and author, title and clamped excerpt.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Pricing card grid on the stock Card, using subgrid rows so titles, prices, descriptions and features align across plans. Gapped cards or a cells plate with hairline gaps; featured is a styling hook.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing Toggle
items.description: Billing period switch, such as monthly and yearly, built on the stock Tabs list. A controlled client component that takes a typed value and a change handler.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate progress bar on Base UI with track, indicator, label and value parts. The root renders the track automatically, so a label and value can sit above the bar.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Step-by-step survey on the @shadcn/react questionnaire primitive with progress, choices, text input, errors and previous, skip, next and submit buttons. Choices show keyboard shortcuts in Geist Mono.

items.name: questionnaire-card-01
items.title: Project Brief Questionnaire Card
items.description: Project brief questionnaire in a card: one question at a time with a progress bar, letter shortcuts, a conditional team-size step and name validation, ending in an answer summary with Edit answers.

items.name: questionnaire-dialog-01
items.title: Project Brief Questionnaire Dialog
items.description: The project brief questionnaire inside a Dialog opened by a Start your brief button: progress, letter shortcuts and a conditional step, with the answer summary and a Done button in the same dialog.

items.name: quote
items.title: Quote
items.description: Testimonial parts: a grid, divided or masonry group whose one to four columns step on a parent Section; figures in default, centred or muted tile style; quotes in four sizes with a byline.

items.name: radar-chart-01
items.title: Listening Moods Radar Chart
items.description: Card with a radar chart scoring six listening moods out of 100, each axis label carrying its score so the values read without the shape. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: radial-chart-01
items.title: Weekly Goal Radial Chart
items.description: Narrow card with a radial ring showing progress toward a weekly listening goal, minutes in the center, the remaining track visible and a footer note. Client component on recharts 3.8.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Base UI radio group with circular items, a filled primary checked state and a centred dot indicator. Items get an enlarged hit area and focus, disabled and invalid styling.

items.name: release-milestones-01
items.title: Changelog Release Milestones
items.description: Changelog layout with an eyebrow, heading and description beside rows of releases. Each row shows a version label and date, then a title and a note.

items.name: repo-deploy-bars
items.title: Repo Deploy Bars
items.description: Bars twin of Repo Deploy: repository, branch and root-directory fields, then a monospace build log that fills on a timer, with progress drawn as segments instead of orb indicators.

items.name: report-issue
items.title: Report Issue
items.description: An issue report card form with Area and Severity selects, a one-line subject and a details textarea, preset to Billing and Serious, ending in a Send report button.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable split panes built on react-resizable-panels with group, panel and handle parts. Works horizontally or vertically, and the handle can show an optional visible grip.

items.name: revenue-dashboard-01
items.title: Revenue Dashboard with Line Charts
items.description: Client revenue dashboard with a 30-day, 90-day or 12-month toggle and four metric cards, each with a total, change badge and recharts line with tooltip. Requires recharts 3.8.0.

items.name: rim-glow
items.title: Rim Glow
items.description: Wrapper that rims its content with a currentColor glow inside and out, in dim, steady or breathing states. Can also cover the viewport as a presence overlay; breathing holds steady under reduced motion.

items.name: ring-loader
items.title: Ring Loader
items.description: Thin ring spinner in five variants, portal, arc, orbit, pulse and crescent, painted from a dusty rose and teal trio set as CSS variables. Reduced motion swaps every spin for a slow breath.

items.name: road-signs
items.title: Road Signs
items.description: North American road sign set: highway guide, exit, next services, mile marker, speed limit and warning diamond on green, blue and yellow faces. Uses the Overpass sign font and Phosphor service icons.

items.name: roadmap-milestones-01
items.title: Horizontal Roadmap Milestones
items.description: Roadmap section with four milestones on a horizontal rule, each with a marker, date, title and line of text. The current milestone carries a Now label.

items.name: scratch-reveal
items.title: Scratch Reveal
items.description: Teal painted panel whose paint wears away on hover to expose a pencil construction sketch, with the label switching to canvas ink. Set in Marcellus; decorative, and reduced motion skips the fade.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Base UI scroll area with a styled viewport and a thin rounded vertical scrollbar; add the ScrollBar part with a horizontal orientation for sideways overflow. The viewport takes a focus ring for keyboard use.

items.name: seat-limit-help
items.title: Seat Limit Help
items.description: Billing help card with seat usage, invoice details, a focusable disabled invite action, and collapsible answers explaining the seat limit and pending invites.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: Page section frame: a container-query band at three paddings around a centred 80rem column, with background, stack or split header, title group, description, width-capped content, columns and actions.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Pill segmented control on Base UI ToggleGroup: a muted track where a lifted card-ground thumb glides to the pressed item, still under reduced motion. Horizontal only; values are arrays, as in Base UI.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Base UI select with trigger, value, grouped items, labels, separators and scroll arrows. The popup aligns the selected item over the trigger by default and marks it with a check.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Base UI separator drawn as a one-pixel border-colored line. Horizontal by default; the vertical orientation stretches to the height of its flex parent.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: An audio loop settings card with m:ss time fields for loop in and loop out, plus fade in and fade out fields in a collapsible section behind a show and hide toggle.

items.name: setup-progress
items.title: Setup Progress
items.description: Onboarding checklist card with a read-only segmented bar counting done tasks, struck-through completed items, inline actions for open ones, a revealable CLI command and a Hide control.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Edge panel on Base UI Dialog that slides in from the top, right, bottom or left over a blurred overlay. Includes header, footer, title, description and a ghost close Button.

items.name: shortcuts
items.title: Shortcuts
items.description: Six outlined link items in a grid, each with a Phosphor icon, title, full description and an arrow, for quick actions such as requesting a planet visit. It steps to two columns by container width.

items.name: side-glow
items.title: Side Glow
items.description: Soft blue radial glow anchored to one edge of a positioned parent: top, right, bottom or left. Ships with SeamLine, a one-pixel overlay-blended rule for marking a panel edge.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App sidebar system with provider, menus, groups, sub-menus, rail and inset layout. Collapses offcanvas or to icons, writes open state to a cookie for defaultOpen, toggles with Cmd or Ctrl+B and is a Sheet on mobile.

items.name: signup-wizard-bars
items.title: Signup Wizard Bars
items.description: Bars version of Signup Wizard: email and password, profile, preference checkboxes and a welcome step, validated with react-hook-form and zod and tracked by plain rail segments.

items.name: simple-footer-01
items.title: Muted Footer with Link Grid
items.description: Plain footer on a muted band: up to five link categories in a grid that sets its own column count from how many there are, and a copyright line. No dependencies.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder: a rounded muted block with a pulse animation. Size and shape it with classes to stand in for text lines, avatars or cards while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range slider on Base UI with a filled track and pill-shaped thumbs. Renders one thumb per array value, two when no array is given, in horizontal or vertical orientation.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Compact SVG line chart from an array of numbers, with a currentColor stroke and fading area fill. Missing values break the line, one point draws a dot, and an aria-label exposes it as an image.

items.name: sphere-button
items.title: Sphere Button
items.description: A round planetary button lit by a radial highlight and crescent inset shadows, in teal, blue and coral. A void variant opens a dark centre on hover; labels set in Marcellus.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator that spins the Phosphor spinner icon. It carries a status role and a Loading label so screen readers announce it, and it sizes to 16px by default.

items.name: split-faq-01
items.title: Split-Row Spaceflight FAQ
items.description: Single-column FAQ in split rows: each question sits left of its answer on wide screens, separated by rules. Copy is a fictional spaceflight booking guide.

items.name: stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: Statistic list on Grid: each stat pairs a large value in the Hanken Grotesk display face with a label, shown plain, on a filled card panel, or with a rule down its left side.

items.name: stats-card-01
items.title: Weekly Support KPI Card
items.description: Compact weekly support metrics card with six figures in two columns, each with a change arrow and comparison text, kept level by a subgrid. Worsening changes show in red.

items.name: status-strip-01
items.title: Service Status Strip
items.description: Slim service status strip with an operational check, three uptime and latency figures and a status page link, reflowing from stacked rows to a single line as it widens.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Composable step indicator with list, item, trigger, indicator, title, separator and content parts. Choose numbered steps or progress bars and one of four rail inks; navigation is linear by default.

items.name: store-header-02
items.title: Minimal Store Header
items.description: Client store header with a centered mega menu of link-only columns, search and bag count, collapsing to a left Sheet with accordion categories when narrow. No announcement bar.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch on Base UI with a pill track and sliding thumb, in default and small sizes. Shows focus rings and invalid styling, and inverts its thumb colors in dark mode.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts for header, body, footer, rows, cells and caption, wrapped in a horizontally scrolling container. Rows highlight on hover and in a selected state.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed panels on Base UI with a pill-shaped default list, or a line variant that marks the active tab with a bar instead. Works horizontally or as a vertical side list.

items.name: testimonial-grid-01
items.title: Testimonial Card Grid
items.description: Heading and description above a three-column grid of six muted quote cards, each with a short quote, a greyscale Cloud Shape avatar, name and role.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field on a soft filled ground that grows with its content through field sizing. Includes focus rings, disabled styling and invalid-state borders.

items.name: three-plan-pricing-02
items.title: Three-Plan Pricing with Highlights
items.description: Three plans in joined pricing cells with none featured, each listing the same four highlights with a check or a muted minus mark so the plans compare at a glance. Pairs with pricing-11.

items.name: timeline
items.title: App Timeline
items.description: Vertical timeline as an ordered list: a ring-and-dot indicator or custom mark per item, a 1px rail joining them, title, description and small label. CSS variables tune dot size and alignment.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked toast notifications on Base UI with a Toaster provider and a shared toast manager. Toasts peek behind each other, expand on hover, swipe to dismiss and show type icons.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state button on Base UI that fills when pressed. Offers default and outline variants in small, default and large sizes, and the variants are exported for reuse.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Group of toggles on Base UI that share variant and size through context. Set spacing to zero to join the items into one segmented control, laid out horizontally or vertically.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus tooltip on Base UI with a provider, trigger and an inverted foreground-color popup with an arrow. Positions to any side, animates in and out, and styles nested keyboard hints.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: Agent activity log: lines with an icon, title and timing, each marked running, error or pending. Running titles shimmer unless reduced motion is set, and steps expand through Collapsible.

items.name: traffic-overview
items.title: Traffic Overview
items.description: Wide card with a two-line chart of views and unique readers, a date-range select, a legend and a dot on the busiest day. The views color changes between light and dark. Uses recharts 3.8.

items.name: two-plan-pricing-02
items.title: Usage-Based Two-Plan Pricing
items.description: Two-plan pricing that sets a free tier with per-item usage fees against a featured paid tier that bundles them, with the fee or included amount in muted text after each metered feature.

items.name: typeset
items.title: Typeset
items.description: The shadcn/typeset stylesheet for prose inside a typeset container: paragraphs, headings, lists, tables and code. Adds docs, editorial and instrument presets; the last needs Instrument Serif installed.

items.name: upload-stages
items.title: Upload Stages
items.description: Compact file-upload card with three accent-colored bar segments for uploading, processing and ready. The current segment pulses while its stage runs and holds still under reduced motion.

items.name: use-cart
items.title: Use Cart
items.description: A client hook for cart state: lines, quantity clamping, remove, clear and reset, plus totals with pluggable shipping and tax estimates. Exports helpers for minor-unit money formatting.

items.name: use-chat-stream
items.title: Use Chat Stream
items.description: A client hook that posts a transcript to a chat endpoint and streams the reply over server-sent events. Accepts OpenAI or Anthropic shaped chunks; exposes send, stop, reset and load.

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: Use Copy To Clipboard
items.description: A client hook that writes text to the clipboard and reports copied for a set timeout, or failed until the next try. A late earlier write never overrides a newer one.

items.name: use-product-filters
items.title: Use Product Filters
items.description: A client hook for faceted product lists: OR within a facet, AND across facets, price bands on number fields, sort options, results and a count of what each option would leave.

items.name: workspace-setup
items.title: Workspace Setup
items.description: Vertical onboarding stepper in a card: each of four steps opens a panel with an input, a primary action and a do-this-later option; skipped steps keep an open ring instead of a check.
